Citation_Information.description:
The FACET_TABLE is the second part of the shape model file providing the linking of vertices into facets. The integers i1 j1 k1 are the indices of the 3 vertices that form triangular facet 1, and so on. The triple defines an outward normal to the facet following the right-hand rule.This faceted shape model of asteroid 1996 HW1 is described in Magri et al. (2011) based on radar observations in 2008 and optical photometric observations from 2005 to 2009. The median model resolution is 113m between vertices.
The model has the format
v x1 y1 z1 v x2 y2 z2 v x3 y3 z3 (etc.) f i1 j1 k1 f i2 j2 k2 (etc.)
where the letter 'v' denotes a vertex and the letter 'f' denotes a triangular facet. The VERTEX_TABLE is the first part, describing the positions of the vertices of the shape model. The floating point numbers x1 y1 z1 are the coordinates of vertex 1, and so on (vertices are implicitly numbered beginning with 1). The origin is the center of mass, and the axes are the principal axes of the shape model. The z-axis is the spin axis or positive pole. The units are kilometers. The linking of vertices into facets is provided in the FACET_TABLE.
This format is identical to a Wavefront OBJ file, supported by NAIF mkdsk and most shape meshing and printing software.
